title: Reaction Module Manifest (draft)
description: DRAFT. Describes a single module declared against a Rearctor reaction at Spark. Field names, value domains and constraints are under research and are not final. This schema does not describe an implemented system.

module_id.description: Stable identifier for this module within the reaction's declared set. Unique per reaction.

version.description: Draft revision of the manifest format this object targets. Not a released version number.

type.description: Module semantics. Closed set: arbitrary user-supplied behaviour is an explicit non-goal.

allocation_bps.description: Claim on the reaction allocation, in basis points of that allocation (not of total fees). Whether a module set must sum to 10000 is an open question.

activation_stage.description: Earliest reaction stage at which this module may execute. Declaration always occurs at Spark regardless of this value.

execution_mode.description: How execution is initiated. 'manual' requires an administrative call; 'scheduled' fires on declared conditions; 'continuous' settles on every qualifying fee event.

hard_budget_ceiling.description: Optional absolute upper bound, independent of allocation_bps. Treated as a ceiling, never a target. Null means no ceiling beyond the bps claim.

amount.description: Base-unit integer as a decimal string, to avoid float precision loss.

parameters.description: Type-specific configuration. Intentionally loose in this draft; per-type schemas are under research.

immutable_fields.description: Fields the creator asserts are frozen at deployment. Under research: this may become implicit in the format rather than declared per manifest.
